direction_definition_unchanged: delta_(s_to_sprime,y) = r_(sprime,y) - r_(s,y), with empirical equal-subject class centroids

source_data_roles.transport_bank_and_support: model-fit subjects, first legal source session only
source_data_roles.independent_class_probe_train: validation subjects, first legal source session
source_data_roles.independent_validation: model-fit and validation subjects, second legal source session only

scaling: unchanged Stage-0 diagonal standard deviation from model-fit bank-session samples only; floor 1e-6

source_support.support_set: all real model-fit bank-session subject-class centroids for the queried class
source_support.candidate_query_support_exclusion: none; candidate queries are independent-session samples and therefore are not identical self-neighbors
source_support.radius_clean_query_exclusion: leave the queried subject centroid out
source_support.distance: mean Euclidean distance to the 3 nearest real same-class bank-session subject centroids
source_support.radius: 95th percentile of clean leave-one-subject-out 3NN mean distances, separately by fold and class

step_solver.rule: largest grid value whose candidate mean-3NN source-support distance is at most the source-only class radius; zero if no positive value is legal

controls.random: deterministic isotropic direction with L2 norm exactly matched to each realized constrained SCST displacement
controls.directional_controls: use the same realized SCST alpha_star for the corresponding pair/sample

diagnostics.norm_ratio: realized transport L2 norm divided by clean standardized-representation L2 norm

success_rule: all seven unchanged gates must pass at final_embedding in all four retained settings
failure_stop_rule: no Repair 3, no SCST training, no future performance, no sealed outer access
